description: Work with your Mixmax email outreach: add and update contacts and contact groups, manage the unsubscribe list, draft and send emails from your own mailbox, read how sent emails performed, and use your saved snippets and meeting types.

mixmax_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when a contact is added to your Mixmax account, in the app, by a sync or through the API, with their email, name and custom fields. Contacts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.meta: The contact's custom fields, such as company or title
output.name: The contact's name, empty if none
output.usedCount: How many times the contact has been emailed
output.userId: The id of the Mixmax user who owns the contact

mixmax_new_email_trigger.description: Runs when you send an email with Mixmax tracking, from Gmail, Outlook, a sequence or the API, with its subject, sender and recipients. Emails sent before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.recipients: Who it was sent to, each with email and name
output.service: The mailbox it was sent through, gmail or outlook
output.serviceThreadId: The conversation's id in Gmail or Outlook
output.subject: The subject line

mixmax_new_unsubscribe_trigger.description: Runs when an address is added to your Mixmax unsubscribe list, whether the person clicked unsubscribe or you added them. Addresses already on the list when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.name: The person's name, empty if unknown
output.orgId: The id of the workspace the list belongs to
